profile.name: Sanjana Londhe
profile.title: AI • Prompt Engineering • Creative Writing
profile.headline: Crafting Intelligent Experiences with AI.
profile.bio: I am a Prompt Engineer and AI Vibe Developer passionate about building human-centric AI applications.
profile.summary: My work combines prompt engineering, Android development, creative writing, and intelligent automation to create software that feels natural, conversational, and useful. I enjoy designing AI workflows, developing Android and web applications, and exploring how creativity can enhance human–computer interaction.

projects.name: Buds
projects.desc: A creative AI chatbot designed to serve as an interactive, empathetic conversational buddy. Built for Android.
projects.problem: Traditional chatbots use rigid, robotic structures that fail to validate emotional nuances, causing users to disengage during times of high emotional distress. Also, chats are automatically saved, violating the sensitivity and sentiments of the users.
projects.solution: Built a multi-mode chat system using Gemini and Android Studio, which enables users to interact freely and safely, with theme preferences.

projects.name: Visa Helper AI
projects.desc: An AI-powered assistant designed to simplify the visa application process. It helps users find the right visa type, gather necessary documents, and understand application procedures—all through an intelligent, conversational interface.
projects.problem: Visa application requirements are spread across confusing government portals, written in complex legal terms, leading applicants to upload incorrect files and face rejections.
projects.solution: Created a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline that indexes immigration policy guidelines and matches query intents, outputting interactive, easy-to-use checklist dashboards.

projects.name: AI Spam blocker
projects.desc: An AI powered application which helps classify spam and ham emails with appropriate explanation
projects.problem: Traditional spam filters only flag messages without explaining why, leaving users in the dark about potential phishing signatures or false positives.
projects.solution: Developed a real-time email parser that processes email bodies, identifies deceptive patterns, and outputs clear reasoning behind spam classifications.

projects.name: EcoTrace
projects.desc: An AI powered application which helps in keeping trace of carbon footprint of any activity
projects.problem: Understanding personal environmental impact is hard due to complex emissions formulas and missing database tracking schemas.
projects.solution: Constructed an Android tracker where Gemini estimates emission metrics from natural language input (e.g. 'drove 15km in a SUV'), maintaining local historical logs.

projects.name: ArenaGenius2026
projects.desc: An AI powered application for regular updates and information regarding FIFA World Cup 2026
projects.problem: Sports news is fragmented, dynamic, and full of clickbait, making it difficult to get objective summaries and timetables.
projects.solution: Engineered an updates portal that crawls verified feeds, aggregates schedule schedules, and responds to natural language sports trivia inquiries.
